close_reason: Known duplication, minor. Both certs_is_ca functions are in different crates with no shared dependency path. Acceptable for v0.1.
description:
pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:113–126 and pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:416–428

Both crates define a near-identical function that returns true iff BasicConstraints cA=TRUE:

pkix-path-builder: cert_is_ca()
pkix-revocation:   cert_is_ca_cert()

Both use the same OID (2.5.29.19), same pattern (extensions.as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]).iter().find().and_then().map().unwrap_or(false)), and same semantics.

pkix-path already performs this check in chain_walk (cert_basic_constraints + .ca), so the logic exists in three places across two crates.  If pkix-path were to expose a helper (e.g., is_ca_certificate) as pub(crate) or a thin public utility in a future version, both duplicates could be removed.

For now, the duplication is a maintenance burden: if the semantics change (e.g., 'no extensions' should be treated differently), two files must be updated.  The cert_is_ca in pkix-path-builder also uses the hardcoded OID string rather than sharing a constant with pkix-path, compounding the duplication.
title: cert_is_ca in pkix-path-builder duplicates cert_is_ca_cert in pkix-revocation
